summary: Example inventory for upgrading a 2.4 multi-node controller and automation hub to a 2.6 enterprise topology: two new gateways, two controllers (peers=execution_nodes), a hop node and two execution nodes, the existing two hubs, two new EDA nodes and a redis group of six hosts.
questions: How do I upgrade a multi-node AAP 2.4 controller and hub to 2.6?
Which hosts go in the redis group in a 2.6 enterprise upgrade?
